title: Alberino measures the Tombs of the Giants

tellings.quote: I went to Sardinia with a tape measure and yes, you can fit the bodies of giants in those tombs.

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast in an episode about claims of giants, says he went to the Italian island of Sardinia to visit the ancient stone graves known locally as the Tombs of the Giants. He says he brought a tape measure, and that the bodies of giants really could fit inside them. To him, it suggests the tombs were built for very large people.
